content.value_statement: Complex ReactFlow projects can become slow and difficult to maintain. This skill provides architecture patterns for hierarchy, layout, state, and performance.
actual_capabilities: Guides ReactFlow node and edge schema design for hierarchical graphs.
Provides expand and collapse patterns for visible node rendering.
Shows memoization, incremental rendering, and layout caching patterns.
Demonstrates Dagre auto-layout and focus-mode navigation patterns.
Describes a graph performance analyzer for reviewing ReactFlow code.
Includes complete React component examples for interactive graph state.
limitations: It provides implementation guidance, not a packaged ReactFlow component library.
Example snippets require adaptation to the target application and data model.
It does not include automated tests, live demos, or installable scripts.
The analyzer example may need project-specific parsing logic.

use_cases.title: Design Product Process Maps
use_cases.description: Create expandable process diagrams that let users inspect categories, steps, and details without rendering every node at once.

use_cases.title: Optimize Large Graph Interfaces
use_cases.description: Improve ReactFlow performance with memoized nodes, incremental updates, cached layout results, and fewer unnecessary re-renders.

use_cases.title: Plan Interactive Architecture Views
use_cases.description: Build node and edge patterns for searchable diagrams, focus mode, undo history, and Dagre-based layout controls.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Graph
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a small ReactFlow view.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a basic ReactFlow graph for my data model. Include node fields, edge fields, and simple interaction handlers.

prompt_templates.title: Add Tree Navigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate hierarchy with expand and collapse behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an expandable ReactFlow tree. Show how visible nodes, parent relationships, and selected state should be managed.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Graph Performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced optimization for a larger graph.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my ReactFlow architecture for performance. Recommend memoization, incremental rendering, caching, and layout improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Architect a Full Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a production graph application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a complete ReactFlow workflow with search, focus mode, undo history, Dagre layout, and large graph performance safeguards.

output_examples.input: A developer needs an expandable department process map.
output: A hierarchy model with root, category, process, and detail node levels.
A visibility strategy that renders only expanded branches.
A state plan for selection, expansion, and layout updates.

output_examples.input: A frontend team reports slow rendering with hundreds of nodes.
output: A performance checklist for memoized node components and stable callbacks.
An incremental rendering approach for expansion changes.
A layout caching plan to avoid repeated Dagre calculations.

output_examples.input: A lead wants a searchable architecture diagram.
output: A search flow that expands parent paths before selecting a result.
A focus mode strategy for isolating direct connections.
A navigation plan using fit-to-view behavior after selection.

best_practices: Keep node and edge data shapes explicit before building interactions.
Render only the graph branches that users need to inspect.
Cache layout results and debounce expensive layout recalculations.
anti_patterns: Rendering every node in a large hierarchy for every interaction.
Mixing manual positioning and automatic layout without clear mode state.
Passing unstable props into custom node components that should be memoized.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design ReactFlow applications with hierarchy, search, focus mode, layout, and performance patterns.

faq.question: Does it include a complete library?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture guidance and examples that developers adapt inside their own React application.

faq.question: Can it help with large graphs?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers incremental rendering, memoization, layout caching, and virtualization-oriented design choices.

faq.question: Does it support Dagre layout?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes Dagre layout patterns for positioning nodes and caching layout results.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it run commands or install packages?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation only and contains no executable installer or command runner.
